summary: Iteration 20 — Dual-scan compact QR voucher verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 7/7 PASS (test_iteration20_qr_dual.py, xdist off): (1) POST /api/vouchers returns absolute scan_url ending in `/?s=<code>` and qr_code base64 decodes exactly to that URL via pyzbar; (2) payload no longer contains `/kasir?scan=`; (3) GET /api/vouchers refreshes stored QR to compact form and returns `_id` as string with zero `$oid` leak; (4) GET /api/vouchers/{id} same contract; (5) unauth POST /api/vouchers/redeem -> 401; (6) authed kasir redeem succeeds once, 2nd attempt -> 400 'sudah pernah'. Frontend Playwright smoke on 390×844 mobile viewport: logged in as super, created+activated an active voucher, navigated to the compact scan_url (`https://…/?s=<code>`). RoleRedirect correctly forwarded to /kasir?scan=<code>; CashierMode redeemed exactly once (data-testid=result-message shows 'BERHASIL!'). Scanner DOM contains #qr-reader with 0 <select> children (no camera picker) and shows the expected localized 'Kamera belakang tidak tersedia' fallback in the preview browser without hardware. GET /api/vouchers via page.request returned no `$oid` and _id string. No pageerror observed.
critical_code_review_comments: generate_qr_base64 uses ERROR_CORRECT_M + box_size=12 + border=4; combined with a short `/?s=<10-char code>` payload this produces a low-density image well-suited to phone-camera capture. Good.
build_voucher_scan_url correctly honours x-forwarded-proto/host so behind the k8s ingress the base URL is https://<host>/ (root path). scan_url invariant `endswith('/?s=<code>')` is enforced.

refresh_voucher_qr is invoked lazily on GET /api/vouchers and GET /api/vouchers/{id}; existing stored vouchers created before this change get their scan_url + qr_code rewritten on first read. Idempotent (skips when scan_url already matches). Good.

CashierMode.getVoucherCode handles all three payload shapes: `?s=CODE` (new), `?scan=CODE` (legacy URL), and raw legacy codes. Post-redemption both ?s and ?scan params are stripped via setSearchParams({replace:true}), preventing repeat-fire on refresh. quickScanRef guards against duplicate scans.

App.js RoleRedirect: only forwards `?s` param, not `?scan`. If someone shares an old `/kasir?scan=CODE` link they still hit /kasir directly (protected route) — that's fine because the CashierMode effect handles ?scan too.

Html5Qrcode is initialised with formatsToSupport=[QR_CODE] and experimentalFeatures.useBarCodeDetectorIfSupported=true, and facingMode {exact:'environment'}. Matches spec. `exact` still hard-fails on desktops without a rear camera (fallback UI shown); intentional per PRD.
PrintVoucher QR image sized 46mm × 46mm with imageRendering: 'pixelated' — up from 40mm. Fallback placeholder box also 46mm. Visual smoke via screenshot confirms crisp appearance on-screen.
server.py is 1100+ lines; refactor into routers/{auth,users,vouchers,settings}.py + services/{email,qr}.py to bring it under the 700-line guideline (repeat from prior iterations, not blocking).
No stored login-activity for failed login attempts — audit trail is success-only (repeat, not blocking).

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: 1 kasir (TESTKasirQR<hex>) + 1 voucher (prefix 'TQ') per pytest run — deleted at fixture teardown. Playwright run: 1 voucher (prefix 'TU') created, redeemed and deleted. Main-agent's original QDT23X9065 was already redeemed by main agent and left in history; main agent will clean it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration20_qr_dual.py is fully self-contained: it logs in as QrDualTest1788690247/654321, creates a temp kasir, creates a TQ-prefixed voucher, and verifies the compact `/?s=<code>` QR payload (pyzbar decodes the base64 image to exactly scan_url), the list/detail refresh path, and the atomic redeem + 401/400 error branches. If pytest.ini enables xdist, pass `-o addopts=` to disable it (this suite doesn't need parallel and fixtures are module-scoped). System dependency added on this environment: `apt-get install -y libzbar0` + `pip install pyzbar` (already installed here). Real hardware-camera decoding is not tested — the app-visible contract is the base64→URL decode and the compact payload length; physical scanning is proxied through pyzbar which uses libzbar (same core library as most phone scanners), so a successful decode is a strong signal.
rca of the issue: Original bug: an absolute `/kasir?scan=<code>` URL was too long/dense for a phone camera to reliably decode from a printed 40mm QR. Fix (implemented by main agent, verified here): (a) shortened payload to `/?s=<code>` at the site root, (b) added a RoleRedirect handler for `?s=` that forwards to /kasir?scan=<code>, (c) reused CashierMode.getVoucherCode which accepts ?s / ?scan / raw code, (d) enlarged the printed QR from 40mm to 46mm with pixelated rendering, (e) constrained the in-web scanner to QR_CODE with native BarcodeDetector, (f) lazy-refreshed old stored QR images on GET so existing vouchers benefit without a migration script. All six invariants of the review request verified — same voucher works from both the phone camera path (payload decodes to the exact scan_url) and the in-web scanner path (getVoucherCode extracts the code from either payload shape).
